messages:
Alice Chen: Quick heads-up — Datadog outreach went well. They want a joint marketplace listing + reference dashboard showcasing Redwood runtime traces and OTLP ingestion. Can we scope a minimal POC for tracing + logs (no heavy instrumentation) and a dashboard template they can embed?

Jasper Patel: +1. I can stand up an OTLP endpoint on staging. Need to confirm which spans/attributes Datadog wants for the demo. Do we have a sample span schema?

maria.sr: We don't have a formal schema yet. For the demo I'd include: service.name, span.kind, http.status_code, model.name, seq_len, latency_ms, gpu_mem_mb. That should show model-level observability.

Dennis K.: FYI some of our agents already emit model.name as tag, but not seq_len. I can add seq_len and latency_ms to the runtime span emitter in a small PR. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Jasper Patel: Great. I'll wire the OTLP endpoint to Datadog's intake token in staging. Quick config snippet for folks who want to test locally: ```yaml
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://otlp-staging.redwood.internal:4317
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS="api-key=staging-XXXXX"
```

Alice Chen: Perfect. Elaine — product/partnerships question: do we want a coordinated announcement or keep this as a partner gallery entry + joint co-marketing later? Also need legal check on use of Datadog logos in dashboards.

Elaine R.: I'd prefer a staged approach: 1) Marketplace listing with an embedded dashboard + install guide, 2) run a joint webinar in ~6 weeks if analytics look good. I'll loop in legal for logo approvals. Can we have the marketplace artifact ready in 2 weeks?

maria.sr: Two weeks is tight but doable if we keep the dashboard minimal and reuse our existing console widgets. I'll draft a dashboard JSON export that Datadog can import and show the key charts: token throughput, median p90 latency by model, error rates, and a trace sample panel.

Dennis K.: PR for span changes linked: <https://git.redwood/repo/commit/abc123>. Once merged, I'll deploy to staging. Expect traces showing seq_len and model.name by tomorrow afternoon.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging/runtime v1.82 -> 1729503000 (in 10m).

Jasper Patel: After deploy I'll send a short curl example to push a synthetic trace and attach the dashboard link for verification.

Alice Chen: Assigning owners: Jasper (OTLP + staging config), Dennis (span emitter PR), Maria (dashboard JSON + docs), Elaine (partner comms + legal). I'll track in the partnership board and follow up in tomorrow standup. :rocket: 

maria.sr: One more ask — can Datadog get read-only access to a sample org so they can preview the marketplace entry? Elaine, can you coordinate access and NDA if needed?

Elaine R.: Yes, I'll request a partner sandbox. Will ping legal on the NDA.

Jasper Patel: I'm pasting a quick test curl for OTLP gRPC->OTLP HTTP bridge (for folks without OTLP tooling): ```bash
curl -X POST https://otlp-gateway.staging/api/v1/traces \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer staging-XXXXX" \
  -d '{"resource": {"service.name": "redwood-runtime"}, "spans": [{"name":"inference","attributes":{"model.name":"mistral-7b","latency_ms":45}}]}'
```

Alice Chen: Awesome — let's reconvene here if blockers appear. Thanks team!
